x: In second place was the much improved Bob Clark (Poly) with Eric Hall occupying the same position as last year, third. Fourth was Stan Vickers and fifth, the Olympic 50 Kilos gold medallist Don Thompson (Met.W.C.)----a nap hand of considerable note!
In the earlier stages, it did seem that George Williams might well gain second place but he was passed, first by Arthur Thomson and later by Bob Clark.
In the Kent Championship, Ken Bailey walked a very fine race to finish 7th over a course which,the winning time of 74:26 by Bob Clark would indicate,is not quite a full 10.
On this occasion however, he was unusually hard-pressed, for Bob Clark was only 90secs away. From the Belgrave viewpoint however, this was a day of bitter disappointment.

The individual race was well and truly won by Paul Nihill (Surrey WC) who had a margin of some 47 secs on the second man home Bob Clark (Poly) with Arthur Thomson (Met.WC) just easing himself into third spot.
John Knifton (BELS) walked a fine race to finish 3rd, 47:52, in this Open 6 miles promoted by Trowbridge A.C. only 16secs behind the winner Bob Clark (Poly) and 6secs behind the second man G.

He had a great scrap with Bob Clark (Poly) before Clark got away in the final stages to beat Ray by a mere 2 seconds. However, the Poly man was not the winner, for Nihill (SWC) had raced away to an untouchable lead and was home nearly 2 mins ahead of the following pair.
